title: Minimum Difference in Sums After Removal of Elements
goal: Remove one third of the values to minimize the first retained half sum minus the second.
strategy: At each split, keep the n smallest values available on the left and the n largest on the right. A max-heap maintains left minima and a min-heap maintains right maxima; compare every valid split.
